props.title: Poltergeist

sections.content: Poltergeist revolutionized supernatural horror by bringing malevolent spirits into suburban America's living room. While officially directed by Tobe Hooper, Steven Spielberg's producing fingerprints are all over this masterpiece - from the wonderous early scenes to the focus on family dynamics. The film spawned countless imitators, including Insidious (2010) and The Conjuring (2013), but none matched its perfect blend of practical effects, genuine scares, and emotional core. The infamous "TV people" scene tapped into widespread anxiety about television's influence on children, while Tangina's "this house is clean" became instantly iconic.

movies.title: The Amityville Horror
movies.slug: A family moves into a supposedly haunted house where a mass murder occurred, facing escalating supernatural terror. The "based on true events" marketing helped launch the haunted house boom.

movies.title: The Entity
movies.slug: Barbara Hershey stars in this disturbing supernatural thriller about a woman terrorized by an invisible force. Released the same year as Poltergeist, it takes a darker, more adult approach.

movies.title: Ghostwatch
movies.slug: This BBC TV movie caused panic when it aired, using the found-footage format to tell a terrifying haunted house story decades before Paranormal Activity.

sections.content: The film's exploration of suburban anxiety hit particularly hard in the early 1980s. Like The Stepford Wives (1975) and Halloween (1978) before it, Poltergeist suggested something rotten beneath America's manicured lawns. The Freelings' cookie-cutter development, built atop a displaced cemetery, spoke to guilt over Native American displacement and rapid suburban expansion. The Changeling (1980) had already proven ghost stories could be sophisticated, but Poltergeist added cutting-edge effects and Spielbergian wonder.

The film's technical achievements can't be overstated. Its practical effects hold up remarkably well, from the bending spoons to the face-peeling sequence. Later films like Beetlejuice (1988) and Ghostbusters (1984) would build on its mix of horror and humor, while the "Carol Anne TV scene" influenced everything from The Ring (2002) to Stranger Things (2016). The tragic deaths of young stars Heather O'Rourke and Dominique Dunne added a dark legacy that spawned rumors of a "Poltergeist curse." SUBHEAD: Legacy and Influence

movies.title: The Changeling
movies.slug: George C. Scott stars in this sophisticated ghost story about a composer who discovers his Victorian mansion harbors dark secrets.

sections.content: Poltergeist's DNA can be found throughout modern horror. Sinister (2012) borrowed its suburban setting and child-in-danger plot, while Paranormal Activity (2007) updated its haunted house formula for the surveillance camera era. The film's PG rating (before PG-13 existed) proved family-friendly horror could still terrify, influencing films like Monster House (2006) and Coraline (2009).
